title: DatasetDM: Synthesizing Data with Perception Annotations Using Diffusion Models
mechanism: A perception decoder trained on about 100 labelled images reads diffusion-model features, so every generated image receives a dense mask.
adaptation: Needs a diffusion model fine-tuned on the EL pool; decoder trained on 478 train cells. Its labels are model predictions on generated cells, close to pseudo-labelling; mainly a canonical benchmark baseline.
min_experiment: Benchmark baseline: PF + DatasetDM pairs vs PF. Metric mIoU_rob and CV inactive IoU. Reported; drop if < +0.005.
evidence: R: state of the art synthetic training on VOC/COCO, more robust domain generalisation, with under 1% labelled images.
prior_overlap: Partly closed: pseudo-label SSL at 100% labels with the 11.9k pool was n.d., and DatasetDM labels are also model predictions; it differs only in generating the images.
